_note: Template for build_annotation_prompts.py and build_annotation_viewer.py. Paths are relative to data_dir. Drop conditions/regulators_by_condition/program_activity for a single-condition screen and use "regulators" instead. condition_design: "unordered" (default; stimuli, donors, cohorts) or "ordered" (timepoints, a dose series). motif_enrichment / candidate_tfs (Stage 2 TSVs) and motif_logos (Stage 2 {K}_motif_logos.json, viewer only) are optional: leave them empty for no TF-motif section.

conditions.label: C1
conditions.description: what distinguishes this condition, e.g. day 1 / IFNG / donor A

settings.cell_system: the cell system and state, as a reader should see it
settings.significance_label: how regulator significance was called, e.g. CRT adjusted p < 0.05 per condition
settings.annotation_role: the specialist the model should act as, e.g. vascular biologist
settings.condition_variable: what the conditions vary, e.g. timepoint, cytokine stimulus, donor, genotype
